svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="JNDn2HbC_N44XRW5p4_E"> <mxGraphModel dx="1132" dy="712" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml STAR_DataWarehouse
' === A4: 21x29.7cm | margin T2.5 B2.5 L3.5 R2 | usable 14.5x24.7cm ===
scale max 1400 width
skinparam defaultFontSize 12
' ============================================================
' Star Schema – Data Warehouse
' Hệ thống MSAS – Phiên bản: 2.0 | Ngày: 2026-05-22
' Cập nhật: Chuẩn hóa Trắng - Đen tuyệt đối cho báo cáo khóa luận
' ============================================================

skinparam defaultFontName \"Times New Roman\"
skinparam defaultFontSize 12
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam monochrome true
skinparam linetype orchestra

' Ép cấu hình Trắng - Đen toàn diện cho các Entity (Bảng dữ liệu)
skinparam entity {
 BackgroundColor #FFFFFF
 BorderColor #000000
 FontName \"Times New Roman\"
 FontSize 11
 HeaderBackgroundColor #FFFFFF
 HeaderFontColor #000000
 AttributeFontColor #000000
}

' Đường liên kết màu đen thuần túy
skinparam arrow {
 Color #000000
 FontColor #000000
 FontName \"Times New Roman\"
 FontSize 10
}

' ═══════════════════════════════════════
' DIMENSION TABLES
' ═══════════════════════════════════════
entity \"dim_date\n[DIMENSION]\" as DimDate {
 * date_key : INT <<PK – dạng YYYYMMDD>>
 --
 * full_date : DATE <<NOT NULL>>
 day_of_week : SMALLINT
 day_name : VARCHAR(20)
 week_number : SMALLINT
 month_number : SMALLINT
 month_name : VARCHAR(20)
 quarter : SMALLINT
 year : SMALLINT
 is_weekend : BOOLEAN
 is_holiday : BOOLEAN
 holiday_name : VARCHAR(100)
}

entity \"dim_product\n[DIMENSION – SCD Type 2]\" as DimProduct {
 * product_key : SERIAL <<PK – surrogate>>
 --
 * product_id : INT <<NK – natural key>>
 * sku : VARCHAR(100)
 * product_name : VARCHAR(500)
 category_name : VARCHAR(255)
 sub_category_name : VARCHAR(255)
 base_price : NUMERIC(15,2)
 cost_price : NUMERIC(15,2)
 brand : VARCHAR(255)
 * effective_from : DATE
 effective_to : DATE
 * is_current : BOOLEAN <<DEFAULT true>>
}

entity \"dim_customer\n[DIMENSION – SCD Type 2]\" as DimCustomer {
 * customer_key : SERIAL <<PK – surrogate>>
 --
 * customer_id : INT <<NK>>
 customer_code : VARCHAR(50)
 * full_name : VARCHAR(255)
 email : VARCHAR(255)
 phone : VARCHAR(20)
 address : TEXT
 district : VARCHAR(100)
 province : VARCHAR(100)
 region : VARCHAR(100)
 segment_label : VARCHAR(50)
 ltv : NUMERIC(15,2)
 * effective_from : DATE
 effective_to : DATE
 * is_current : BOOLEAN <<DEFAULT true>>
}

entity \"dim_channel\n[DIMENSION]\" as DimChannel {
 * channel_key : SERIAL <<PK – surrogate>>
 --
 * channel_id : INT <<NK>>
 * channel_name : VARCHAR(255)
 * channel_type : VARCHAR(50)
 platform : VARCHAR(100)
 is_online : BOOLEAN
 is_active : BOOLEAN
}

entity \"dim_region\n[DIMENSION]\" as DimRegion {
 * region_key : SERIAL <<PK – surrogate>>
 --
 * province : VARCHAR(100)
 region : VARCHAR(100)
 zone : VARCHAR(100)
 country : VARCHAR(100) <<DEFAULT 'Việt Nam'>>
}

entity \"dim_payment_method\n[DIMENSION]\" as DimPayment {
 * payment_key : SERIAL <<PK – surrogate>>
 --
 * payment_method : VARCHAR(100)
 payment_type : VARCHAR(50)
 provider : VARCHAR(100)
}

' ═══════════════════════════════════════
' FACT TABLES
' ═══════════════════════════════════════
entity \"fact_sales\n[FACT]\nGrain: 1 order_item × ngày × kênh\" as FactSales {
 * sales_key : SERIAL <<PK>>
 --
 * date_key : INT <<FK → dim_date>>
 * product_key : INT <<FK → dim_product>>
 * customer_key : INT <<FK → dim_customer>>
 * channel_key : INT <<FK → dim_channel>>
 * region_key : INT <<FK → dim_region>>
 * payment_key : INT <<FK → dim_payment_method>>
 external_order_id : VARCHAR(200) <<UQ>>
 company_id : UUID
 -- Measures — Doanh thu cơ bản --
 order_count : INT <<DEFAULT 1>>
 item_quantity : INT
 gross_revenue : NUMERIC(15,2)
 discount_amount : NUMERIC(15,2)
 net_revenue : NUMERIC(15,2)
 cost_amount : NUMERIC(15,2)
 gross_profit : NUMERIC(15,2)
 profit_margin : NUMERIC(8,4)
 shipping_fee : NUMERIC(15,2)
 return_count : INT <<DEFAULT 0>>
 return_amount : NUMERIC(15,2) <<DEFAULT 0>>
 -- Measures — Lợi nhuận 3 tầng --
 cogs_amount : NUMERIC(18,2)
 estimated_platform_fee : NUMERIC(18,2)
 estimated_payment_fee : NUMERIC(18,2)
 estimated_packaging_cost : NUMERIC(18,2)
 estimated_shipping_cost : NUMERIC(18,2)
 estimated_total_fee : NUMERIC(18,2)
 estimated_net_profit : NUMERIC(18,2)
 gross_profit_margin : NUMERIC(10,4)
 estimated_net_profit_margin : NUMERIC(10,4)
 missing_cost : BOOLEAN <<DEFAULT false>>
 is_fee_estimated : BOOLEAN <<DEFAULT true>>
}

entity \"fact_ad_performance\n[FACT]\nGrain: chiến dịch × ngày × kênh\" as FactAd {
 * ad_key : SERIAL <<PK>>
 --
 * date_key : INT <<FK → dim_date>>
 * channel_key : INT <<FK → dim_channel>>
 * product_key : INT <<FK → dim_product>>
 campaign_name : VARCHAR(255)
 -- Measures --
 impressions : INT <<DEFAULT 0>>
 clicks : INT <<DEFAULT 0>>
 spend : NUMERIC(15,2) <<DEFAULT 0>>
 conversions : INT <<DEFAULT 0>>
 revenue : NUMERIC(15,2) <<DEFAULT 0>>
 ctr : NUMERIC(8,6)
 cpc : NUMERIC(10,2)
 roas : NUMERIC(8,4)
}

entity \"fact_shipping\n[FACT]\nGrain: ngày × kênh × tỉnh\" as FactShipping {
 * shipping_key : SERIAL <<PK>>
 --
 * date_key : INT <<FK → dim_date>>
 * channel_key : INT <<FK → dim_channel>>
 * region_key : INT <<FK → dim_region>>
 carrier_name : VARCHAR(100)
 -- Measures --
 order_count : INT <<DEFAULT 0>>
 delivered_count : INT <<DEFAULT 0>>
 return_count : INT <<DEFAULT 0>>
 total_shipping_fee : NUMERIC(15,2) <<DEFAULT 0>>
 avg_delivery_days : NUMERIC(5,2)
 success_rate : NUMERIC(5,4)
}

entity \"fact_payment\n[FACT]\nGrain: ngày × kênh × PTTT\" as FactPayment {
 * fact_payment_key : SERIAL <<PK>>
 --
 * date_key : INT <<FK → dim_date>>
 * channel_key : INT <<FK → dim_channel>>
 * payment_key : INT <<FK → dim_payment_method>>
 -- Measures --
 transaction_count : INT <<DEFAULT 0>>
 total_amount : NUMERIC(15,2) <<DEFAULT 0>>
 refund_amount : NUMERIC(15,2) <<DEFAULT 0>>
 gateway_fee : NUMERIC(15,2) <<DEFAULT 0>>
 success_count : INT <<DEFAULT 0>>
 fail_count : INT <<DEFAULT 0>>
 success_rate : NUMERIC(5,4)
}

' ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
' QUAN HỆ STAR SCHEMA (Điều hướng Layout tự động bằng - và .)
' ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
' Bảng Fact trung tâm lớn nhất
DimDate ||..o{ FactSales : \"date_key\"
DimProduct ||--o{ FactSales : \"product_key\"
DimCustomer ||--o{ FactSales : \"customer_key\"
DimChannel ||--o{ FactSales : \"channel_key\"
DimRegion ||..o{ FactSales : \"region_key\"
DimPayment ||..o{ FactSales : \"payment_key\"

' Các bảng Fact vệ tinh
DimDate ||--o{ FactAd : \"date_key\"
DimChannel ||..o{ FactAd : \"channel_key\"
DimProduct ||..o{ FactAd : \"product_key\"

DimDate ||--o{ FactShipping : \"date_key\"
DimChannel ||--o{ FactShipping : \"channel_key\"
DimRegion ||--o{ FactShipping : \"region_key\"

DimDate ||--o{ FactPayment : \"date_key\"
DimChannel ||--o{ FactPayment : \"channel_key\"
DimPayment ||--o{ FactPayment : \"payment_key\"

@enduml",
 "format": "svg"
}" id="b9yGHV0bFQeIlzpKIbw3-84"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="666" width="1401" x="20" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
